answer: Each agent must bond a stake locked to a hardware-attested identity, and rewards unlock only after sustained verified work, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per node. Like a river carving through basalt, repeated legitimate contributions accrue reputation that a fresh sybil account cannot counterfeit, while a wide ocean of disposable keys gains nothing because payouts scale with stake at risk. Attackers must burn funds on every identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator qwe0004 applies this at deUGZD8U1p.
